# Codex specialist personas

Select persona-code-reviewer, persona-security-auditor, persona-test-engineer or persona-web-performance-auditor explicitly to adopt a specialist role in the current chat. Direct role adoption is not independent review.

workflow-review and workflow-test run their workflows in the main session. workflow-webperf delegates one specialist if the host supports it, or clearly discloses same-context execution. workflow-ship uses three independent reviewers and main-session synthesis, subject to its capability requirements and small-change exemption.

A persona may use the bundled underlying workflows but must not call another persona. Native subagent availability depends on the host and current session; installing a skill does not enable it.
